verdict.rationale: Paperspace's GPU cloud page says outright that you can bring your own SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access. The machine docs back this up: SSH connection is documented, and authentication is a choice made at machine creation. One community user says getting SSH access was 'an uphill battle' because of the console and GUI. That is a complaint about difficulty, not a report that SSH or root access fails, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on SSH key management and root/sudo specifics (the root claim is marketing-level only), and independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth SSH/root workflow.
